::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru startup led by co-founder and CEO Parag Naik (earlier co-founded Saankhya Labs). Signed an MoU with BharatGen in February 2026 to co-develop AI chipsets and an India-centric AI software stack. Pre-silicon.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Chipsets for consumer electronics, IoT and AI inference, co-designed with India-centric AI models.
